notes.title: Beatfinder Sneak Peek is live!
notes.content:
[h1] Beatfinder Sneak Peek! [/h1]

Hey everyone!

We’re super excited (and honestly a little nervous) to finally share the [b]first public version[/b] of [b]Beatfinder[/b] with you!
For [b]one week only[/b], you can dive into a hand-drawn rhythm-runner where you’ll jump, slide, and kick your way across rooftops to the beat of our very own music track.

There’s one level, one playable hero (shoutout to Caizzo the Monkey Monk!), and enough cultists to keep you on your toes.
Just in time for [b]Polish Constitution Days[/b]

[h3]Important![/h3]
This is an early look, not the final game.
There might be a few rough edges — we’re still polishing (see what we did here?) everything — but your feedback will mean the world to us.

[h3]When?[/h3]
The sneak peek will be available for one week (April 26 – May 3), then it’s back to the lab for more work!

Thank you so much for checking out [b]Beatfinder[/b]. ❤️
We’re a tiny team trying to make something fun, and having people play it this early is already a huge win for us.
Play the demo, break things, and tell us what you think!
We’re reading [b]every piece of feedback[/b] (memes included)!

See you on the rooftops,
The Relentless Effort Games team
